scope: successor contract for authority operator-rekey receive after PR #41
claim_boundary: This file freezes required successor semantics and executable model evidence. It does not claim that the blocked Session/#40/transport-owner integration is implemented on this branch.

invariants.property: Expected peer Proposal nonce domain is bound immutably at authority activation and cannot be supplied or substituted per rekey call.
Wrong sender/source/payload/epoch domain is rejected before current-key decrypt and before live replay mutation.
An envelope authenticating only under a previous/grace key is rejected before live replay mutation.
Exact-current-key authentication uses the live Session replay window exactly once; authenticated semantic rejection remains replay-consumed.
Semantic-invalid current-key Proposal preserves active key, authority lineage, and outbound nonce state while retaining replay consumption.
Ack encoding/preseal is the final fallible stage inside the Wire receiver transaction; any preseal failure preserves key, lineage, and outbound nonce state.
After all fallible Wire checks succeed, one commit advances active key and authority lineage together, reserves Ack as new-key sequence zero, and leaves live outbound sequence at one.
The live Session is the sole long-lived owner of the active AEAD key; no duplicate current-key verifier copy or temporary decrypt Session is retained.
Local sender nonce domain used to seal Ack remains distinct from the immutable expected peer Proposal nonce domain.
Final production interoperability is exercised against xenia-peer #188 with exact host Proposal and console Ack domains on the final qualified Wire lineage.

After Wire commits and returns the exact presealed Ack, the transport owner sends that Ack exactly once while application authority remains suspended; reported send failure before or after possible byte escape is session-fatal, never rolls key/lineage back, and never application-level reseals or retries the Ack on the same connection.

promotion_order: implement #38 current-key-only live receive without duplicate active-key ownership
rebase/reconstruct #41 semantics on final nonce-safe lineage
bind immutable expected peer Proposal NonceDomain at activation
bind returned Ack to one transport-owned send attempt with authority suspended until the send outcome is known
run receiver Ack send-before-write and send-after-write ambiguity regressions
